DE-FE0032254 In comparison to the monolith-based technology, which has a cost of capture of $349/tCO , the structured 2 sorbent filter DAC technology has a cost of capture of $241/tCO yielding savings of over $110/tCO as a 2 2 result of significant reductions in capital, fixed, and variable costs (Figure 21). Notably, the configuration proposed in the original design as part of DE-FE0032243 employed a more expensive monolith coating process, the sorbent’s kinetics were slower, and a CO recovery step was included. Compared to the 2 structured material assembly (SMA), the structured sorbent filter has a lower thermal mass, which results in reduced power requirement for sorbent regeneration. Moreover, due to its roll-to-roll manufacturing process and inexpensive materials, unit cost of manufacturing is lower. Furthermore, because of the faster sorbent kinetics and the removal of the CO recovery step, more cycles can be run per day. 2 Figure 21.
